items.text: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् देवीं सरस्वतीं चैव ततो जयमुदीरयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तप्तहाटककेशान्त ज्वलत्पावकलोचन वज्राधिकनखस्पर्श दिव्यसिंह नमो ऽस्तु ते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पान्तु वो नरसिंहस्य नखलाङ्गूलकोटयः हिरण्यकशिपोर्वक्षःक्षेत्रासृक्कर्दमारुणाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: हिमवद्वासिणः सर्वे मुनयो वेदपारगाः त्रिकालज्ञा महात्मानो नैमिषारण्यवासिनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ये ऽर्बुदारण्यनिरताः पुष्करारण्यवासिनः महेन्द्राद्रिरता ये च ये च विन्ध्यनिवासिनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: धर्मारण्यरता ये च दण्डकारण्यवासिनः श्रीशैलनिरता ये च कुरुक्षेत्रनिवासिनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कौमारपर्वते ये च ये च पम्पानिवासिनः एते चान्ये च बहवः सशिष्या मुनयो ऽमलाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: माघमासे प्रयागं तु स्नातुं तीर्थं समागताः तत्र स्नात्वा यथान्यायं कृत्वा कर्म जपादिकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नत्वा तु माधवं देवं कृत्वा च पितृतर्पणम् दृष्ट्वा तत्र भरद्वाजं पुण्यतीर्थनिवासिनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तं पूजयित्वा विधिवत्तेनैव च सुपूजिताः आसनेषु विचित्रेषु वृष्यादिषु यथाक्रमम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: भरद्वाजेन दत्तेषु आसीनास्ते तपोधनाः कृष्णाश्रिताः कथाः सर्वे परस्परमथाब्रुवन्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कथान्तेषु ततस्तेषां मुनीनां भावितात्मनामाजगाम महातेजास्तत्र सूतो महामतिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: व्यासशिष्यः पुराणज्ञो लोमहर्षणसंज्ञकः तान् प्रणम्य यथान्यायं स च तैश्चाभिपूजितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: उपविष्टो यथायोग्यं भरद्वाजमतेन सः व्यासशिष्यं सुखासीनं ततस्तं लोमहर्षणम् स पप्रच्छ भरद्वाजो मुनीनामग्रतस्तदा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: भरद्वाज उवाच शौनकस्य महासत्त्रे वाराहाख्या तु संहिता त्वत्तः श्रुता पुरा सूत एतैरस्माभिरेव च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सांप्रतं नारसिंहाख्यां त्वत्तः पौराणसंहिताम् श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं सूत श्रोतुकामा इमे स्थिताः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अतस्त्वां परिपृच्छामि प्रश्नमेतं महामुने ऋषीणामग्रतः सूत प्रातर्ह्येषां महात्मनाम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कुत एतत्समुत्पन्नं केन वा परिपाल्यते कस्मिन्वा लयमभ्येति जगदेतच्चराचरम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: किं प्रमाणं च वै भूमेर्नृसिंहः केन तुष्यति कर्मणा तु महाभाग तन्मे ब्रूहि महामते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: कथं च सृष्टेरादिः स्यादवसानं कथं भवेत्कथं युगस्य गणना किं वा स्यात्तु चतुर्युगम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: को वा विशेषस्तेष्वत्र का वावस्था कलौ युगे कथमाराध्यते देवो नरसिंहो ऽप्यमानुषैः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: क्षेत्राणि कानि पुण्यानि के च पुण्याः शिलोच्चयाः नद्यश्च काः पराः पुण्या नृणां पापहराः शुभाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: देवादीनां कथं सृष्टिः मनोर्मन्वन्तरस्य तु तथा विद्याधरादीनां सृष्टिरादौ कथं भवेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यज्वानः के च राजानः के च सिद्धिं परां गताः एतत्सर्वं महाभाग कथयस्व यथाक्रमम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सूत उवाच व्यासप्रसादाज्जानामि पुराणानि तपोधनाः तं प्रणम्य प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणं नारसिंहकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पाराशर्यं परमपुरुषं विश्वदेवैकयोनिं विद्यावन्तं विपुलमतिदं वेदवेदाङ्गवेद्यम् शश्वच्छान्तं शमितविषयं शुद्धतेजोविशालम् वेदव्यासं विगतशमलं सर्वदाहं नमामि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नमो भगवते तस्मै व्यासायामिततेजसे यस्य प्रसादाद्वक्ष्यामि वासुदेवकथामिमाम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सुनिर्णीतो महान् प्रश्नस्त्वया यः परिकीर्तितः विष्णुप्रसादेन विना वक्तुं केनापि शक्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तथापि नरसिंहस्य प्रसादादेव ते ऽधुना प्रवक्ष्यामि महापुण्यं भारद्वाज शृणुष्व मे
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: शृण्वन्तु मुनयः सर्वे सशिष्यास्त्वत्र ये स्थिताः पुराणं नरसिंहस्य प्रवक्ष्यामि यथातथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नारायणादिदं सर्वं समुत्पन्नं चराचरम् तेनैव पाल्यते सर्वं नरसिंहादिमूर्तिभिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तथैव लीयते चान्ते हरौ ज्योतिःस्वरूपिणि यथैव देवः सृजति तथा वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पुराणानां हि सर्वेषामयं साधारणः स्मृतः श्लोको यस्तं मुने श्रुत्वा निःशेषं त्वं ततः शृणु
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च वंशो मन्वन्तराणि च वंशानुचरितं चैव पुराणं पञ्चलक्षणम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: आदिसर्गो ऽनुसर्गश्च वंशो मन्वन्तराणि च वंशानुचरितं चैव वक्ष्याम्यनुसमासतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).
